design_notes: Each itinerary has a flight over 10 hours to Hong Kong (765 or 770 minutes) and one of 5 hours or less on to Haneda (240 or 245). The class is set per flight (line 132). The Director's note allows the next higher class for work on arrival (line 144), but only the 'Over 5 hours' row carries '(but see below*)' (line 134); the 'Up to 5 hours' row is plain economy (line 133). Yet the footnote's own grounds include 'short duty visits out and back in a working day' (lines 140-141), which are short flights, so it may reach them too. The offer sells premium economy on both flights. Hold the premium economy fare, or the economy fare of the stricter reading.
